In Hdt. and Att. to say, speak, affirm, declare: absol. seq. orat. dir. al. seq. ὅτι recit. al. acc. et. inf. al. after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, al. ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), al. of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, al. of writing, al. λέγει ἡ γραφή, al. c. acc. rei, al. σὺ λέγεις (a non-committal phrase; Swete, Mk., 359, 369 f.); c. dat. pers. seq. orat. dir. al. mult. id. seq. ὅτι, al. c. prep. πρός, μετά, περί, etc. al. to mean (cl.), al. to call, name; pass. al (cf. ἀντι-, δια- (-μαι), προ-, συλ-λέγω). SYN.: λαλέω, which refers to the utterance, as λέγω to the meaning of what is said, its correspondence with thought (Tr. Syn., Ixxvi; Thayer, s.v. λαλέω).
